sourceReview.scope: Tracked and nonignored untracked candidates; ignored private configuration/runtime state is not read. Binary files are hashed, not credential-scanned; pattern scanning is not exhaustive secret detection.

tests.name: Nightshift adapter sends the real provider contract and preserves reported model identity
Nightshift unauthorized and malformed output remain distinct controlled failures
an output-limit response cannot become an accepted proposal even when its prefix is valid JSON
malformed model identity is rejected without inventing or echoing metadata
Zetaris adapter uses fixed queries, numeric conversion, source versions, and fresh evidence
Zetaris stale observations and unsafe configured identifiers fail closed
upstream response parser enforces a byte limit
live API requires its own token and does not silently enter sample mode
evaluation cannot pass missing, skipped, failed or unknown matrix evidence
public review catches new untracked credentials and private dependencies while ignoring runtime configuration
evaluation fault set: TLS failure, rate limit, authentication and timeout reject without fallback
candidate citations cover only its supplier, courier and used edges; duplicate rows deduplicate and hashes survive another query
every required selected-candidate citation is enforced even when a controlled Critic approves; unrelated citations are unnecessary
missing or tampered observations fail candidate checks; blocked paths require complete graph evidence
source validation refuses empty candidate set
source validation refuses empty graph
source validation refuses missing graph edge
source validation refuses cross-tenant candidate
source validation refuses cross-tenant edge
source validation refuses conflicting supplier facts
source validation refuses conflicting courier corridor
source validation refuses conflicting edge facts
source validation refuses unknown graph node
source validation refuses stale edge
source validation refuses future supplier clock
source validation refuses null stock
source validation refuses blank price
source validation refuses same source aliases
explicit partial/truncated responses and invalid positional rows fail closed
positional SQL rows preserve tenant/projection order and normalize typed numeric strings
unsafe identifiers, external tenants and arbitrary SQL never reach the transport
simulator: same trusted intent, separate amounts, scoped retries after expiry and one execution owner
http_gateway: same trusted intent, separate amounts, scoped retries after expiry and one execution owner
HTTP gateway: committed response loss recovers one job/intent/outbox after adapter reconstruction
HTTP gateway: signed identity plus trusted persisted approval rejects spoofing, tampered terms and incompatible versions
HTTP gateway: parallel approvals and provider contention cannot produce simulator side effects or duplicate jobs
HTTP gateway: incompatible/misbinding responses and stale revisions fail closed; no synthetic fallback
HTTP gateway: an actual bounded timeout after commit retries the same job
HTTP gateway: definitive quote/provider conflicts require a fresh plan and approval, without substitution
execution 1.0 schemas are strict and explicit; unknown/minor versions require reviewed migration
NVIDIA-direct uses only NVIDIA credentials and the reported model, with no Nightshift fallback
unknown inference provider or non-Nemotron model cannot trigger a call
preflight checks Zetaris even when inference and Relay credentials are missing
Nightshift route discovery and successful inference do not attest an underlying Nemotron identity
preflight keeps sample mode offline even with configured sponsor values
bounded draft extraction finds canonical fields and clarifies conflicting, unsupported and fractional constraints
incomplete drafts persist needs_input without sources, inference, memory-derived requirements or tasks
explicit confirmation resumes the same mission and normal checked approval path while retaining the original deadline
reviewed fields resolve conflicts, stale revisions and unconfirmed/mismatched bodies cannot plan
waiting and editing cannot reset or extend a draft deadline, even if deadline is supplied after clarification
allowlisted actions reject SQL, URLs, unknown keys and dispatch; injected decisions cannot bypass observed stages
different observations change next actions: no stock skips courier/route reads, no courier skips routes, feasible stock proposes
Critic refresh and one repair share six reads; exhaustion does not perform a discarded extra refresh
injected selection calls consume the same total inference budget as Planner/Critic
the overall deadline bounds adapters that ignore cancellation and persists failure without dispatch
caller cancellation propagates through the shared signal and blocks late model results
stock, named edge and entrance changes produce structured replacement receipts that need fresh approval
material price, ETA and courier changes never execute the old terms
a decline releases the slot, excludes that courier only for this mission, and duplicate or old events cannot replan again
cancellation confirms only local simulation, releases once at every active stage, and stale outbox or old cancel cannot resurrect tasks
revisions and allowed transitions reject stale/out-of-order responses, while duplicates and legacy tasks remain safe
failed replanning after decline preserves the released task and can be explicitly retried without extending the deadline
late planning success or failure cannot overwrite a task approved and cancelled during that planning run
duplicate source controls are no-ops, unknown IDs and cross-owner lifecycle changes preserve state
budget and time alternatives use separate eligible sets, exclude unproven options and explicitly explain combined or unavailable cases
infeasible receipts report when neither single relaxation works and never modify quantity, compatibility or deadline
real serial process restarts prove both-role recall, corrected task terms, stale-approval rejection, forgetting and scope isolation
well-formed legacy state is adopted, unrelated factual memory is excluded and preserved by correction/forgetting
forget-and-reconfirm cycles never revive an old approval even when the effective preference returns to empty
corrupt, missing, mismatched and interrupted memory files are preserved and block new planning/approval with secret-free errors
unreadable files and failed vendor writes are controlled failures; no cached preference or automatic repair follows
namespace loss and inconsistent legacy pairs are not interpreted as first-use empty memory
Runtime projection correlates receipt/request/model/provider and preserves requested versus effective routing without private content
malformed or conflicting Runtime provenance fails closed instead of inventing an underlying identity
Nightshift adapter carries correlated Runtime identity; provider failure never falls back to a direct endpoint
preflight distinguishes Runtime-correlated Nemotron routing from an unmatched configured model label
full Nightshift mission verifier requires explicit live authorization before loading private configuration or calling a service
mission history is chronological with stable ties, ownership-independent filtering and access beyond four rows
live maps use fresh receipt route facts and never substitute sample stock/couriers/edges
NVIDIA direct, Runtime, sample and unresolved inference labels stay distinct
changed-plan and approval views render deterministic terms, IDs and fresh confirmation without trusting summary text
browser requests prevent later mutations after cancellation and keep network/auth failures actionable
independent Critic identifies a legitimate invalid proposal; one targeted repair changes the selection
correct null reports terminate with independent approval and cite the checked observation set
wrong outputs cannot dispatch even if a controlled Critic approves; only bounded safe codes are retained
invalid or contradictory Critic contracts are never approvals; a single rejection remains independent
a citation omission is repaired using exact missing IDs and the same four-call budget
deterministic financial text and stored receipt terms remain authoritative, with infeasible approval blocked
invalid mode and out-of-range port cannot silently start another configuration
writer lock excludes another process, preserves stale locks and resolves path aliases
second app on another port cannot write the same H-MEM; graceful close permits persistent restart
occupied ports fail before store initialization and never print credential-bearing errors
passive readiness is authenticated, secret-free, and does not promote configured keys to verified calls
actual adapter observations preserve last success, distinguish authentication failure and do not invent model identity
plain preflight stays offline even when private configuration selects live mode
independent preflight failure states include time and authentication without raw upstream text
managed sample start is idempotent, stop preserves data and restart retains H-MEM for both services
normal request produces a checked receipt and exactly one task on duplicate approval
stock change rejects the old approval and creates a critiqued replacement
expired proposal cannot dispatch and absolute mission deadline is preserved
tight budget returns the computed $2 minimum change without creating a task
route closure changes the computed path and invalidates approval
confirmed H-MEM preference survives reload, is injected, changes approval, and can be forgotten
another demo identity cannot read missions, approve plans, or recall preferences
courier decline releases the task and proposes an alternative requiring new approval
task progresses through acceptance and delivery and invalid transitions are rejected
different approval payload cannot reuse the same idempotency key
pending outbox delivery recovers after a database reopen without duplicating the task
sample execution makes no outbound fetch calls
negative, fractional, and extra request fields are rejected at the boundary
unavailable dependencies produce controlled failure and never create a task
schema-invalid proposals exhaust a bounded loop and cannot dispatch
evidence export is ordered, machine-readable, and identifies the actual mode
Runtime URL normalization never duplicates /v1
